author: dinall
text:
I built ThumbAPI to simplify generating thumbnails, OG images, blog images and socials posts covers for automations and apps.

Visual types: - Faceless (abstract) - Personalized with photo - Branded with logo - Custom assets as dataset - REST API

Main focus was making it simple and fast to integrate.

Would appreciate feedback on: - API design - documentation - pricing/free tier - integrations people would want

Happy to answer technical questions.
